locked_before: All final runs (training, cross-validation, test). Not changed after seeing results.
label_window_rule: Models are fitted on follow-up up to 1,825 days: an interval (L, R] keeps its original bounds when L < 1,825; if L >= 1,825 the visit is censored at 1,825. The longest evaluation time frame is 1,095 days.
primary_comparison: M3 - M2 on the same visits with complete M3 inputs

decision_rule.Added value: lower 95% bound of AUC gain > 0 AND AUC gain >= 0.02 AND lower bound of net-benefit gain > 0
decision_rule.Equivalent: 95% interval of AUC gain within (-0.02, 0.02) AND upper bound of net-benefit gain <= 0.01

reporting_rule: Report cross-validation (80% training data) and the 20% test set separately. The test set is an internal check on an ADNI split used in earlier analyses. Unless both reach 'Added value', the summary statement is: 'Not enough evidence that the atrophy rate from repeat MRI adds consistent prognostic value'.

cv.preprocessing: Head-size adjustment and trend (BLUP) parameters estimated within each fold, including inner folds, using only participants outside the evaluated part
cv.inner_score: held-out interval-censored log-likelihood, unpenalised, with the same per-participant weights (1/n_i) as in fitting

mri_series_rule_primary: same FreeSurfer version and field strength; S10 also requires the same scanner manufacturer and model
mri_same_day_rule: different field strengths on the same day: keep the participant's most common field strength (ties: 3T); repeat scans with the same protocol: average
clinical_conflict_rule: two different values for the same participant and day: drop the measurement and log it in conflicts.csv
demographics_rule: education and sex use the latest record on or before the visit (negative missing codes ignored); participants with inconsistent valid values are logged in conflicts.csv and excluded in S7
imputation_primary: intervals crossing the time point (L<h<R): onset time drawn from M0 (neutral reference), once per repeat
calibration: Turnbull NPMLE across 10 risk groups; overall predicted/observed ratio

sensitivity.L1: leakage audit: preprocessing parameters fitted on all training data
sensitivity.S1: standard Cox model using the diagnosis visit as the event date
sensitivity.S6: onset time for crossing intervals: last negative visit, midpoint, diagnosis visit, drawn from M3
sensitivity.S7: excluding participants with inconsistent sex or education
sensitivity.S8: MRI processing delay: MRI at least 1, 7 or 30 days before the visit
sensitivity.S9: MRI age: coverage with 180/365-day windows, performance by MRI age, volume x MRI-age interaction
sensitivity.S10: MRI series from the same scanner model

exploratory: All sensitivity and subgroup analyses are exploratory and do not replace the main conclusion.

amendments.change: S7 changed from 'exclude inconsistent sex' to 'exclude inconsistent sex or education (valid codes)'
amendments.reason: All 45 apparent sex conflicts were the missing code -4; after removing missing codes, 0 participants had conflicting sex and 95 had conflicting education.

amendments.change: Model fitting window extended from 1,095 to 1,825 days; two 365-day baseline pieces and one open-ended piece added.
amendments.reason: Keeping the right bound of intervals that cross day 1,095 while censoring event-free follow-up at 1,095 leaves no exposure after day 1,095, so that baseline piece degenerates (log-hazard -4.2 in a technical test run; no performance metrics had been viewed).

amendments.change: Lambda grid widened from [0.1, 1, 10] to a half-decade log grid 0.1-1000; inner-loop score uses the per-participant weights 1/n_i of the fitted likelihood; IPCW-weighted confusion-matrix metrics at the app risk-band thresholds added as descriptive secondary metrics. Decision rule, margins, time frames, folds and repeats unchanged.
amendments.reason: v7 chose lambda = 10, the upper end of the grid, in 372/400 choices of the main CV, so the optimum could lie outside the grid; and the unweighted inner score did not match the weighted fitting objective. A check of the inner-CV score alone on the training data (no performance metric viewed) placed the optimum at about 30-300. Results of v7 had been seen, so all analyses were rerun under this amendment and both versions are reported.

classification.thresholds: the two risk-band cut-offs of the app (lowest and highest core net-benefit threshold, 15% and 30%)
classification.metrics: IPCW-weighted confusion matrix: sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV, F1, share flagged
classification.role: descriptive secondary metrics; not part of the decision rule
